summary: Stores a schema on a sheet and applies what it describes.
description: The schema is written into the sheet's developer metadata, so it travels with the sheet — a copy of the spreadsheet carries it, and `getSchema` finds it again without reading a single cell.
The description is also put into effect: the header row is written and the columns get the formatting and the validation their types imply.

params.schema: The schema: its `version`, the `headerRow` and the `columns`.

throws.InvalidSheetException: the first argument is not a sheet.

examples.title: Declaring a schema
